answer: Build membership like a reef: every fresh account needs an existing member to vouch for it, staking the sponsor's own reputation on that account's uniqueness. A tide of clones then demands an equal mass of real collateral, and when a sybil cluster is exposed, every vouch behind it is slashed. An attacker rents the inlet from honest agents instead of spamming it, because a bad vouch corrodes the vouch-er's own voting weight.
